US tells allies to choose sides in AI race with China

The United States is instructing its partners to select sides in the global artificial intelligence (AI) competition with China. A draft letter from the State Department, addressed to signatories of a U.S. "AI Opportunity Statement," warns that nations aligning with China's AI framework will be excluded from U.S.-led coalitions. This directive aims to prevent countries from joining Beijing's competing AI initiatives, highlighting the strategic importance of the AI race.
